reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: One of the few cleanser with no coconut deprived surfactant
reviews.zh: 係少數冇用椰子來源表面活性劑嘅潔面產品之一。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: Pleasant facial soap, no scent. Does not dry out the skin. Suitable for oily skin prone to acne and pimples. Soothes and does not cause redness.
reviews.zh: 用起上嚟舒服嘅洗面皂，冇香味。唔會令皮膚繃緊。適合容易爆瘡、暗瘡嘅油性肌。舒緩皮膚，唔會引起泛紅。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: A repurchase. Nothing else cleans my skin like this!
reviews.zh: 回購之選。冇其他嘢可以好似佢咁清潔到我嘅皮膚！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: This cleanser doesn’t leave my skin stripped and doesn’t dry me out. Takes some time to rinse but very effective.
reviews.zh: 呢隻潔面產品唔會令皮膚繃緊，亦唔會抽乾水分。需要啲時間先沖得甩，但好有效。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: First time trying it, for my oily skin
reviews.zh: 第一次試，俾我呢個油性肌用。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: The SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam was okay, but it didn’t leave a strong impression. It cleanses well and removes excess oil, leaving the skin feeling fresh. It doesn’t foam very much, the texture is creamy, and personally I didn’t find it very convenient to use. I didn’t notice any significant improvement in breakouts. Overall, it’s a decent product, but I probably wouldn’t repurchase it.
reviews.zh: SKIN1004 馬達加斯加積雪草 Tea-Trica BHA 泡沫潔面普普通通，但冇畀到我深刻印象。清潔力唔錯，可以去除多餘油脂，用完皮膚感覺清爽。起泡量唔算多，質地係忌廉狀，個人覺得唔算好用。爆瘡方面我冇見到明顯改善。整體嚟講係一款 OK 嘅產品，但我未必會回購。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: I’ve been struggling with a particular very stubborn blemish and this cleanser seemed to help from the first time I used. Hopefully this will be the one to disappear it entirely!
reviews.zh: 我一直被一粒好頑固嘅瑕疵困擾，用咗呢隻潔面產品第一次就好似有幫助。希望呢隻可以幫我完全褪走佢！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Tea-Trica BHA Foam 125ml
reviews.text: This foam cleanser is a game-changer for acne-prone and sensitive skin. Its rich, gentle bubbles provide deep cleansing without irritation, leaving my skin feeling refreshed, balanced, and healthy. Perfect for daily use!
reviews.zh: 呢隻泡沫潔面係暗瘡肌同敏感肌嘅救星。豐富溫和嘅泡沫可以深層清潔又唔刺激，用完皮膚感覺清爽、平衡、健康。非常適合日日用！
